description: Synthetic sesslint.diff.v1 schema parity. Constraints and expected rejections come from the pinned schema. Documents are constructed objects, not SessionDiff.to_dict output. No session text is stored.
known_parity_gaps: diff.py imports sesslint.canonical, sesslint.adapters, and sesslint.report. Those imports are refused, so SessionDiff.to_dict is not executed.
tests/cli/test_diff.py::test_diff_json_output_schema calls the CLI and checks several fields. validate is one document, not that sweep.
tests/cli/test_diff.py::test_diff_json_validates_against_schema calls diff_sessions and load_diff_schema. One object is not that sweep.
Duplicate JSON object keys are a syntax refusal. Python json.loads keeps the last key, so that case is not a vector.
uniqueItems, minLength, maxLength, and pattern are absent from the pinned schema. A schema that stated them fails closed as unsupported.
